                    ### Question
                    A 46-year-old woman comes to the physician for a follow-up examination after a Pap smear showed atypical squamous cells.                     ### Options

opb. Right supraclavicular
opc. Inferior mesenteric
opd. Superficial inguinal
ope. Left supraclavicular
